issues.summary: Section nav with a filter active. A chip whose section the filter hides falls through to native <a href="#ppk-section-…"> navigation. The click does nothing visible and pushes a history entry with history.state === null. Next's popstate handler ignores such entries, so the next item window's close (router.back()) lands on that entry while the router stays on /production-control/item/<id>. Reproduced on the stand: filter 'Частично', click chip '2. План ХАССП', open item 1.1, Escape. URL is /production-control#ppk-section-plan, and clicking 1.1 again does not open the window. PpkStructureRefresh (pathname === '/production-control') also stops refreshing statuses.
issues.fix: Always call event.preventDefault() in the chip onClick. If the target section is not rendered, first reset the filter (flushSync(() => setFilter("all")) from react-dom, or setFilter("all") then requestAnimationFrame) and then scrollIntoView and focus as now. Alternative: render the chips as buttons without href.

issues.summary: Regression on the objects list (/settings/buildings) on phones, caused by the rename. The card header row (flex items-center gap-2, no wrap) holds the name <h2> and the sphere chip. With the new food label the chip becomes 124x106 px (5 lines), and the object name shrinks to a 40 px column that reads 'Каф / е / «Ро / маш / ка»'. With the previous label 'Общепит ХАССП' the name was 81 px wide. Food is the most common sphere; the uz label is even longer (62 chars), the en one shorter (32).
issues.fix: Let the header row wrap: 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1' on line 658, plus min-w-0 / break-words on the <h2>. The chip then goes under the name on narrow screens and desktop stays one line.

issues.summary:
The 'compact' starter card is less compact on phones than the card it replaces (owner: 'компактнее на странице'; Р2). The text

is 'min-w-0 flex-1' (flex-basis 0), so flex-wrap never moves the 185 px button to a new line and the text is squeezed beside it. Measured new vs previous markup: iPhone 13 329 vs 245 px tall, text column 101 vs 256 px; 320 px phone 391 vs 314 px, text column 31 vs 186 px; Pixel 7 247 vs 222 px.
issues.fix:
Give the text a real basis so the button wraps under it on phones, e.g. 'min-w-[14rem] flex-1' (or 'basis-full sm:basis-0 sm:flex-1') on the

. Optionally make the button w-full under sm. Desktop stays one row (card <= 72 px).

issues.summary: For medical/consumer/sport objects the starter card stays visible after the sphere pack is applied, because the condition is still 'all PPK blocks < 40% done'. Opening it then shows 'Всё уже заполнено, ничего не добавлено' with Fill disabled. That message (wizard line 175) is past tense before any action.
issues.fix: Hide the card when every block of starterBlocksFor(defaultSphere) is filled, and use a present-tense 'nothing to add' text in the dialog.

issues.summary: { sphere: "food" } without kind returns 400 'Неизвестный тип заведения', although the spec describes the contract as { sphere, kind? }. The wizard always sends kind, so the UI is unaffected.
issues.fix: Default kind to "cafe" whenever a sphere is given, keeping 400 for an invalid explicit kind and for legacy {}.

issues.summary: Р5 says scroll is locked on <html>, but the fix only stops <body> being a scroll container and relies on react-remove-scroll's wheel/touch blocking. Keyboard and scrollbar can still scroll the page under a window. This is unchanged from before, so not a regression; it is a deviation from the spec wording.
issues.fix: Record the deviation in evidence, or accept it. Locking <html> would bring back the scrollbar-width shift the 2026-11-23 rule removed.

issues.summary: loadOverviewSignals (revision states and Postgres sha256 fingerprints) runs on the default view of the section's main page with no fallback. Any error in it now takes down /production-control instead of only the revisions page (owner: 'ничего текущего не сломало').
issues.fix: Wrap it as loadOverviewSignals(scope).catch(() => null), so a failure falls back to the classic page.

issues.summary: Pre-existing: the success toast says '1 норматив' because created.norms counts the single norms record, while the dialog promised '7/10 нормативов'.
issues.fix: Use summary.norms (or the length of the selected norms) in the toast when created.norms is set.
